subject: Request to shift live demo — Luminex on the road (trade show overlap)
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@luminex.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <epark@luminex.com>
Date: Sun, Aug 1, 2027 at 10:02 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Demo next week — possible to move?

Hi Irene,

Quick note — thanks again for scheduling the live walkthrough for next Wednesday. We just got our booth assignment and several members of the product team will be on the floor at the same time, so the core decision-makers who planned to attend will be pulled to the trade show during your slot.

Would it be possible to either:
- Move the live demo to Thursday morning (preferable), or
- Have a colleague of yours run the session on Wednesday and share a recording afterwards so our execs can watch on the plane?

We can share the trade show itinerary if that helps coordinate. Apologies for the short notice — this was only confirmed today.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Product, Luminex
attachments: Luminex-trade-show-itinerary.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@luminex.com>
Cc: Emily Park <epark@luminex.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Aug 2, 2027 at 09:15 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Demo next week — possible to move?

Hi Samir —

Totally understandable, thanks for flagging. We have two practical options and I want to make this as easy as possible for your team: 

1) Move the live demo to Thursday 8/5 at 10:00 AM PT (we've got a slot open) — same agenda and team.
2) Keep Wednesday's slot and have Jonas run the walkthrough (he can take the technical questions) while we record the session and follow up with a short clippings pack + recording.

If you expect execs are only free outside show hours, option 2 + a recording might be the safest route. We'll also attach our internal runbook for handing demos to a backup presenter so Jonas can step in with minimal context.

Can you confirm which you prefer? If it's option 2, please confirm who will be the on-site contact (Emily?) and any narrow timing constraints for the recording.

I can also share a shortened agenda tailored for a recorded walkthrough — 20 minutes demo, 10 minutes Q&A highlights — if that helps the exec viewers.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192
attachments: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf
From: Samir Rao <samir@luminex.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <epark@luminex.com>
Date: Tue, Aug 3, 2027 at 08:47 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Demo next week — possible to move?

Irene —

Thanks for the quick options. We’ll go with option 2: keep the Wednesday slot and have Jonas present. Emily will be the on-site contact (she's cc'd) and will make sure the decision-makers get the recording.

Couple of asks so Jonas can be prepared:
- Can you include a minute at the start that calls out model quantization/latency tradeoffs? That’s the top question from our infra team.
- If you can share the recording within 3 hours after the session, that would be ideal (flight windows).
- Emily — I’ll give you a heads-up with a short note when the execs step away from the booth so you can cue the session.

Appreciate the runbook. Emily, if anything changes on your side let us know.

Samir
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@luminex.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Aug 9, 2027 at 04:20 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Demo next week — possible to move?

Hi Samir and Emily —

Thanks for confirming and for the heads-up, Samir. I’ll run the Wednesday session at the scheduled time (Aug 4, 2:00 PM PT) and will be sure to:
- Start with a 3-slide overview on quantization & latency tradeoffs tailored to infra teams,
- Hit the production routing & fallback section (per your infrastructure concerns),
- Record the session and upload the full recording plus a 6-minute highlights clip within 2 hours of finishing.

Emily — could you send a quick note with the booth number and the best phone to reach you during the session? That’ll help if we need to coordinate a hard start/stop.

Irene/Grace — I’ve attached the checklist I’ll use to make the handoff smooth.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
